items.question: What is ScoutPaw TV?
items.answer: ScoutPaw TV is a calming entertainment brand for dogs and the people who love them. Led by five animated pups — Max, Rocky, Oscar, Buddy, and Bella — it pairs gentle music and soothing visuals with a small shop of pup-friendly gear, all designed around a relaxed, cozy mood.

items.question: Can calming music and sounds help my dog relax?
items.answer: Many dog owners play soft, steady music or ambient sound to create a calmer environment, and some studies suggest certain dogs settle more easily with gentle audio in the background. Every dog is different, so treat ScoutPaw as a relaxing companion rather than a medical solution — for anxiety or behavioral concerns, talk to your veterinarian.

items.question: Where can I watch ScoutPaw videos?
items.answer: You can browse the full library on the Watch page at scoutpaw.tv, and subscribe to the ScoutPaw channel on YouTube to follow new releases. Videos stream for free.

items.question: Who are the ScoutPaw characters?
items.answer: The pack has five members: Max the Golden Retriever, Rocky the Husky, Oscar the Collie, Buddy the Corgi, and Bella the Poodle. Each has their own personality, song, and story, and you can meet them all on the Characters page.

items.question: Is ScoutPaw content free to watch?
items.answer: Yes. ScoutPaw videos are free to stream. The brand also offers an optional shop with plushes, prints, apparel, and accessories for fans who want to bring the pack home.

items.question: Can I leave ScoutPaw playing while I'm away from my dog?
items.answer: ScoutPaw is made to play comfortably in the background during naps, quiet time, or while you step out. Use your own judgment about volume and screen time, and make sure your dog always has water, comfort, and a safe space.

items.question: What kind of music and sounds does ScoutPaw use?
items.answer: ScoutPaw focuses on gentle, low-key audio — soft melodies, calm ambient tones, and easygoing soundscapes chosen to feel soothing rather than stimulating, so the mood stays relaxed for both dogs and their humans.

items.question: Does ScoutPaw sell merchandise?
items.answer: Yes. The ScoutPaw shop carries character plushes, posters, stickers, apparel, and other pack gear. You can explore the current lineup on the Shop page at scoutpaw.tv.
